explanation: Osamu Tezuka's Astro Boy began on Japanese TV on 1 January 1963. The Simpsons' first half-hour episode aired in December 1989, after more than two years of shorts.

claims.text: The Astro Boy TV series began on Japanese television on 1 January 1963.
The first half-hour episode of The Simpsons aired on 17 December 1989.
The Simpsons appeared as short cartoons for more than two years before its first half-hour episode.

writerNotes: Twenty-six years apart. Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Claims: every claim listed, risk at or above the C26 floor; the schema's riskReason list has no only or counterintuitive, so such claims carry the nearest listed reason. Datasets: no pinned dataset covers film or TV facts, so every high-risk claim here needs checker evidence from the web. Rival test: Arguing for The Simpsons: anime can feel like a 1980s import, but Astro Boy began on TV in 1963. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: a Japanese and a US series, both known worldwide. Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 28 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json, no match. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: none beyond the high-risk claims flagged for external evidence.
